email_body:
Dear ECI Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Communications Trainee position at European Cycling Industries. With a background in digital marketing, SEO and content, I am drawn to ECI's work promoting cycling as a sustainable and innovative mobility solution across Europe.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage website content, write SEO articles and support social media and digital communications for client sites. Previously, at Knowledge Experts, I built and maintained WordPress websites, prepared presentations and ran analytics reporting. I am fluent in English, have a good command of Dutch, and am comfortable using Canva, MailChimp and Microsoft Office. I also have experience with CRM systems and event promotion through my work on various digital campaigns.

I am eager to contribute to ECI's communications and advocacy activities, including the annual ECI Summit, and to gain hands-on experience within a European trade association. I have the legal right to work in Belgium and am available to start as soon as possible.

Thank you for considering my application.

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear ECI Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Communications Trainee position at European Cycling Industries. As a digital marketer with a technical background and a strong interest in sustainability and mobility, I am excited by the opportunity to support ECI's communications and advocacy work in Brussels.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and content creation for client websites, using tools like Semrush, Google Analytics and Search Console to track performance. I also manage WordPress sites, ensuring consistent layout and up-to-date content. Previously, at Knowledge Experts, I built SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for major clients and designed WordPress websites from structure to content and social media integration. These experiences have given me a solid foundation in digital communications, content management and analytics.

I am fluent in English and have a good command of Dutch, with Turkish as my native language. I am proficient in Microsoft Office and have used Canva for visual design, as well as MailChimp for email campaigns. My work on event promotion and stakeholder monitoring has honed my organisational skills and attention to detail. I am particularly drawn to ECI's mission to promote cycling as a sustainable and innovative mode of transport, and I am eager to contribute to the annual ECI Summit and other advocacy activities.

I have the legal right to work in Belgium and am available to start as soon as possible. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my skills can support ECI's communications goals.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Fluent in English and has a good command of Dutch, with native Turkish; strong interest in sustainability and mobility.
• Experienced in digital communications: website content management, SEO writing, social media integration, and analytics reporting.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office, Canva, MailChimp, and CRM systems; familiar with WordPress and Elementor.
• Organised and detail-oriented, with experience in event promotion and stakeholder monitoring.
• Holds a completed degree in Applied Computer Science and is legally entitled to work in Belgium.
